Fabric/common Kotlin Gradle project for Minecraft 1.20.4 using Gradle 8.14.3, Loom 1.10 and JDK 17. The Java toolchain/release is 17. Release tag environment suppresses the upstream timestamp suffix in archive names. Fabric metadata independently uses 1.2.2+1.20.4.

Fabric compile target is 1.20.6, but versions/1.20.6-fabric/gradle.properties explicitly lists 1.20.4 in game_versions and metadata permits >=1.14. Official release is intentionally cross-version; Fabric Java bytecode target is 8. Build JVM 21 is required for 1.20.6 game artifacts. Gradle 8.8. Exclude the upstream compile prerequisite licenseFormatMain to prevent tracked copyright rewrites; the existing license headers remain preserved. BUILD_RELEASE=true sets metadata to 1.0.2.

Build worldedit-fabric for Minecraft 1.20.4 with Java 17 and Gradle 8.5. Select its six required projects with minefedPlatform=fabric so unused Bukkit adapters do not resolve retired Paper development bundles; the upstream default project list is preserved. remapShadowJar produces the standalone Fabric distribution with nested Fabric modules. Metadata appends the current short Git commit to version 7.3.0; worldedit-mod:jar combines Fabric and Forge and is not selected. Opt into Java 21 only for ANTLR generation to avoid the Gradle 8.5 worker bootstrap failure on non-ASCII Windows paths; Gradle and mod compilation remain on Java 17.

Select the Minecraft 1.20.4 Fabric projects in the multi-version Architectury tree. Run common:gen-1.20.4 first to generate assets/data, licenses/terms and built-in resource packs, then remap 1.20.4:fabric in a separate invocation. Generated outputs are ignored build directories. Use official Gradle 8.8 with build JDK 21 and Java 17 mod bytecode. No all-version build or clean-all task is selected.
